prose: Like the priest-craft of old, modern medicine is based on arcane systems of thought, invisible causes, and fabricated histories. Genetics, epidemics, germs, and all those diseases we allegedly cured are founded on some very flexible statistics...

Dr. Marizelle Arce returns to InnerVerse to chat about the history of medicine's divergent terrain vs. germ philosophies. We discuss environmental and lifestyle factors of health, misconceptions about genetics and "viruses", and pleomorphism and microbial adaptability.
ext: We discuss German New Medicine, parenting and childhood health, what earwax tells the terrain doctor, and whether EMF is dangerous.
